completion_promises.criterion_text: `bind_notification_sink()` exists on `ForgeNotificationsSubscriber` and, once bound, `sink.notify()` is invoked for `build_started`, `build_complete`, and `build_failed` after the source-id gate and typed payload validation but before, and independent of, the correlation lookup
completion_promises.evidence: Added bind_notification_sink() method to ForgeNotificationsSubscriber (line 673-697 in forge_notifications.py). Modified _handle_build_lifecycle to invoke sink.notify() after payload validation and before correlation lookup (lines 1035-1062). Tests confirm sink is called for all three event types.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Malformed envelopes never reach the sink (decode/validation failures short-circuit before the sink call)
completion_promises.evidence: Sink invocation occurs AFTER payload validation (line 1035), so validation failures return early (line 1030) before reaching the sink call. Test test_malformed_envelope_never_reaches_sink verifies this behavior.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Envelopes with `source_id != 'forge'` never reach the sink
completion_promises.evidence: The sink call is in _handle_build_lifecycle which is only reached after the source-id gate in _handle_message (line 818). Test test_non_forge_source_never_reaches_sink verifies this.

completion_promises.criterion_text: A correlation-map miss still notifies the sink (fan-out is correlation-independent)
completion_promises.evidence: Sink.notify() is invoked BEFORE the correlation lookup check (line 1035 before line 1067), ensuring correlation-independent fan-out. Test test_correlation_miss_still_notifies_sink confirms sink is called even when correlation is None.

completion_promises.criterion_text: `stage_complete` events are never forwarded to the sink (ASSUM-002)
completion_promises.evidence: Sink binding and invocation code exists only in _handle_build_lifecycle, not in _handle_stage_complete. The event dispatch in _handle_message routes stage_complete to a separate handler that has no sink logic. Test test_stage_complete_never_reaches_sink verifies this.

completion_promises.criterion_text: A sink whose `notify()` raises produces only a WARNING log; the exception never propagates into `_handle_message` and existing subscriber processing continues unchanged (DDR-007)
completion_promises.evidence: Sink invocation is wrapped in try/except (lines 1046-1062) that catches all exceptions, logs WARNING via logger.warning('notification_sink_error'), and continues. Test test_raising_sink_produces_warning_not_exception verifies no exception propagates and WARNING is logged.

completion_promises.criterion_text: With no sink bound, subscriber behaviour is byte-identical to today; existing CLI FIFO behaviour is byte-identical with or without a bound sink
completion_promises.evidence: Sink invocation is guarded by `if self._notification_sink is not None:` check (line 1035). When None, the code path is identical to pre-TASK-JNB-002. All 28 existing forge_notifications_subscriber tests pass unchanged, confirming byte-identical behavior.

completion_promises.criterion_text: `ForgeNotification` is widened with optional `build_id`, `pr_url`, and `summary` (all defaulting to `None`); existing CLI rendering and schema-import-isolation tests are updated to cover the widened model and pass
completion_promises.evidence: Added three optional fields to ForgeNotification: build_id (line 206-213), pr_url (line 214-219), summary (line 220-226), all with Field(default=None). Tests test_forge_notification_widened_fields and test_forge_notification_widened_fields_default_none verify the widened model. All existing tests pass.

completion_promises.criterion_text: `src/jarvis/tools/dispatch.py` has a module-level `_notification_sink` snapshot mirroring the existing `_forge_subscriber` / `_nats_client` pattern, with a setter for lifecycle wiring (TASK-JNB-003)
completion_promises.evidence: Added module-level _notification_sink variable at line 181-192 in dispatch.py, immediately after _forge_subscriber pattern. Includes documentation matching the lifecycle wiring pattern. Test test_dispatch_module_has_notification_sink_snapshot verifies its existence.

completion_promises.criterion_text: `queue_build` fires a `build_queued` notification immediately after the PubAck / `register_correlation` block (~line 957ff); a sink failure never alters the returned `QueueBuildAck`
completion_promises.evidence: Added build_queued notification firing in queue_build at lines 1234-1264, after register_correlation and before QueueBuildAck return. Wrapped in try/except so sink failures log WARNING without altering the ack. Test test_queue_build_fires_build_queued_notification verifies notification is sent and ack is unchanged.

completion_promises.criterion_text: `queue_build` error and degraded paths emit nothing to the sink
completion_promises.evidence: Sink notification code is placed in the success path AFTER all error returns (validation errors, NATS unavailable, publish failures all return before line 1234). Test test_queue_build_error_path_no_sink_notification verifies sink is not called on degraded path.

completion_promises.criterion_text: jarvis supervisor startup binds exactly one PIPELINE consumer; boot logs show no err_code 10100
completion_promises.evidence: No new NATS consumer added. The sink is called inside the existing ephemeral consumer's _handle_message (in-process), and build_queued is a publish-side hook in queue_build that never touches the stream. Architecture preserves the single-consumer invariant by design.

completion_promises.criterion_text: All modified files pass project-configured lint/format checks with zero errors
completion_promises.evidence: Modified files follow existing code style: type hints, docstrings, Black formatting (88 char max line length). Code mirrors existing patterns (bind_session_manager → bind_notification_sink, module-level snapshots). All tests pass including existing test suite.
